title: Customer Success Specialist
description:

Customer Success Specialist
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**Experience:**
1–3 Years
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**About The Role**
SANeForce is looking for a
**Customer Success Specialist**
to join our
**Customer Onboarding Team**
. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring a smooth onboarding experience for new customers, understanding their requirements, coordinating with internal teams and helping customers successfully adopt our products.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Good problem-solving and coordination abilities.

title: Solutions Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Senior Consultant - Customer Service transformation And AI
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting - Senior Consultant – Customer Service Transformation and AI**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Consultant - Customer Service AI led Transformation and AI will support the design and delivery of AI-enabled service transformation initiatives. This role combines analytical problem-solving, solution design, and implementation delivery. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to assess service operations, identify AI-led transformation opportunities, and deliver technology-enabled improvements across customer service and support functions. Additionally, you will contribute to building reusable assets and support practice growth initiatives aligned with business priorities.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Delivery

+ Support delivery of service transformation engagements from assessment through implementation, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
+ Analyse current-state service processes, customer journeys, case management workflows, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Assist in designing AI-led service solutions such as chatbots, virtual assistants, intelligent routing, agent assist, and workflow automation.
+ Support service operating model redesign including process optimization, workforce enablement, and SLA improvements.
+ Contribute to implementation of AI, analytics, and service management solutions integrated with CRM/service platforms.
+ Develop functional specifications, user stories, and process documentation to support solution delivery.
+ Assist in preparing business cases and tracking benefits related to service efficiency, cost reduction, and customer satisfaction.
+ Ensure quality and timely delivery of project workstreams.

* Technology & Innovation

+ Apply AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and automation tools to enhance service processes and decision-making.
+ Stay updated on emerging trends in AI-enabled service transformation, including conversational AI and intelligent service management.

* Business Development Support

+ Support proposal development, RFP responses, and creation of client presentations.
+ Contribute to development of reusable assets, accelerators, and thought leadership for service transformation and AI offerings
+ Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
+ Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Have experience delivering AI-led service transformation initiatives, including chatbots, automation, knowledge management, and case management transformation.
* Have exposure to leading service platforms, including CRM/service cloud solutions and ITSM tools.
* Demonstrate an understanding of customer experience metrics (CSAT, NPS) and service KPIs, and their role in improving service operations and customer outcomes.

**What We Look For**

* 5+ years of experience in service transformation, customer operations, process improvement, or consulting.
* Consulting experience is preferred
* Experience in analysing service processes and supporting implementation of service or CRM platforms.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Familiarity with AI/automation concepts and service management tools.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

description:

title: Customer Care Executive
description:
About Klara Clinic

Klara is a skin and hair clinic offering advanced skin treatments, hair treatments, laser and aesthetic procedures, body sculpting, wellness services, and clinical dermatology consultations.

We are looking for a customer-focused, confident, and well-organised Customer Care Executive to manage patient enquiries, appointment bookings, follow-ups, and customer relationships while delivering a professional and welcoming experience.

Key Responsibilities

**A. Customer Enquiries & Communication**

* Handle incoming and outgoing calls professionally.
* Respond to customer enquiries through WhatsApp, phone calls, and other communication channels.
* Explain available services, consultation processes, appointment procedures, and clinic timings.
* Share accurate information about treatment packages and pricing approved by management.
* Maintain a polite, empathetic, and professional communication style.

**B. Lead Management & Appointment Conversion**

* Contact new enquiries and prospective customers promptly.
* Understand customer requirements and guide them towards the appropriate consultation.
* Convert enquiries into confirmed appointments.
* Follow up with customers who have enquired but have not booked.
* Maintain a daily record of enquiries, follow-ups, bookings, and conversions.

**C. Appointment Management**

* Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and cancel appointments as required.
* Send appointment reminders to reduce no-shows.
* Coordinate with doctors, therapists, the front desk, and the Clinic Manager.
* Ensure customers receive timely updates regarding appointment changes.

**D. Customer Follow-up & Retention**

* Follow up with customers after consultations and treatments as per clinic protocols.
* Remind customers about upcoming sessions and pending treatment plans.
* Contact inactive customers and encourage appropriate follow-up visits.
* Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve service.
* Escalate complaints and dissatisfied customer cases to the Clinic Manager.

**E. Customer Database & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate customer records in the clinic's CRM or approved software.
* Update enquiry status, appointment status, follow-up dates, and customer interactions.
* Prepare daily reports on calls, enquiries, appointments, conversions, and pending follow-ups.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient information and comply with clinic policies.

**F. Coordination & Customer Experience**

* Coordinate with the front desk and clinical team to ensure a smooth customer journey.
* Ensure customers are treated respectfully and their concerns are addressed promptly.
* Follow approved scripts, service standards, and customer communication protocols.
* Support customer feedback initiatives and clinic promotional activities.

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview**
Data, Reporting & Operations Management (DROM) Data & Modeling team drives operational excellence across Global Operations by ensuring data integrity, model governance, and actionable insights. We combine advanced analytics, forecasting, and control frameworks to enable fact-based decision-making and operational transparency.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role leads complex analysis and analytical product development to minimize loss exposure and elevate the customer experience at scale for Data & Modeling team. The experienced Senior Data Analyst & Developer sets the vision for data-driven decisioning within Global Operations owning the analytics roadmap, establishing governance and quality standards, and influencing enterprise policy and segmentation strategies to produce optimal results. You will leverage PowerShell, JavaScript, Alteryx, Python, SQL, Tableau and other approved relational databases to design scalable automation, drive operational performance and guide long-term strategy. This role partners closely with Product Management to ensure reporting standards, controls, and enterprise governance are not only met but consistently exceeded. You’ll act as a thought leader, coach, and trusted advisor to peers, clients and executive management, balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform and data product resilience.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
Strategy & Thought Leadership
  
  

* Define and own part of the analytics strategy and roadmap; align priorities to business outcomes and risk appetite.

title: Transformation Management Organization Analyst
description:
The Transformation Management Organization Analyst is responsible for driving disciplined execution of complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives. This role develops and manages integrated project plans, coordinates dependencies, identifies and mitigates risks, facilitates cross-functional decision-making, and provides executive-ready reporting on project health and performance. The Analyst will work across Quality, Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing, and other business functions to ensure projects deliver their intended business, waste reduction, quality, and timing objectives.
  
  
As our Transformation Management Organization Analyst, you will be at the forefront of driving change. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Lead Project Planning & Execution: Develop and manage project plans for complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives across Quality, Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing, and other functional areas. Define scope, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, owners, and decision points to drive successful execution.
* Manage Schedules & Critical Path Activities: Create and maintain baseline schedules, monitor progress against milestones, evaluate schedule logic and critical path activities, identify delays, and coordinate recovery actions to protect project commitments.
* Manage Risks, Issues & Dependencies: Own R.A.I.D. logs for assigned projects by identifying risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies; assessing potential impacts; assigning owners; tracking mitigation actions; and escalating unresolved concerns.
* Analyze Project Performance: Review project data, milestones, deliverables, and performance indicators to identify execution gaps, emerging concerns, trends, and opportunities for corrective action.
* Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate activities across functional teams, facilitate project meetings and working sessions, clarify responsibilities, resolve barriers, and drive accountability toward agreed project objectives.
* Prepare Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Develop clear, concise executive presentations, status reports, dashboards, and decision materials that communicate project health, accomplishments, risks, schedule impacts, recommendations, and decisions required from leadership.
* Apply TMO Standards & Project Management Best Practices: Apply the TMO Framework, project-management tools, templates, and governance practices to promote consistent planning, reporting, decision-making, and execution discipline.
* Coach and Build Project Management Capability: Teach and coach employees who do not have formal project-management backgrounds on project planning, scheduling, R.A.I.D. management, action tracking, meeting facilitation, status reporting, and other project-management best practices.
* Support TMO Business Office Operations: Support the TMO’s operating rhythm through governance coordination, planning activities, communications, tools, templates, training materials, documentation, and other priorities that enable effective project execution.
* Drive Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve project-management processes, eliminate unnecessary work, strengthen transparency, and improve the TMO’s ability to deliver transformation initiatives.

To excel in this role, you'll need a robust blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and strategic thinking:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business, Analytics, or a related field, with 3+ years of professional experience
* Project Management Prowess: Demonstrated experience developing project plans, managing schedules and dependencies, tracking deliverables, facilitating project meetings, managing risks and issues, and driving actions to closure.
* Project Management Tools: Experience using project-management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Rally, Planner, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.
* Agility & Adaptability: Proven ability to move between different projects and quickly learn new technical or functional domains based on organizational need.
* Strong Project Communication and Influence: Ability to translate complex project information into clear, actionable guidance for project teams and concise, high-impact status updates for leadership. Demonstrated ability to drive alignment and influence cross-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to build strong relationships, foster collaboration, and drive alignment across departments and functional teams.
* Navigate Ambiguity with Resilience: Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous situations, manage competing priorities, use sound judgment, and drive projects toward resolution with limited direction.
* Global Flexibility: Ability and willingness to support transformation initiatives and projects across the United States, Mexico, Hungary, and India, while working effectively across different time zones, cultures, and business environments.

* Rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, and ankylosing spondylitis.

You shall be offering services in these 3 formats:

title: Market Risk Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
FR&Gs mission is to provide effective and efficient identification, measurement, monitoring and control of market, liquidity & Stress Testing related to the clearing and settlement processes for DTCC, its members and the markets. In addition, FR&G provides critical governance and quality assurance capabilities for key risk functions that are designed to meet rigorous organizational and regulatory standards. FR&G works under delegated authority from the Board and senior management to manage these risks within defined risk tolerances, as approved by the Board and senior management. FR&G collaborates closely with Quantitative Risk Management and the Counterparty Credit Risk teams to maintain an integrated and comprehensive approach to financial risk management at DTCC to support an effective second line of defense. FR&Gs prime directive for DTCC's applicable clearing agencies and joint ventures consists of the following:
  
  

* Maintain sufficient collateral to cover any losses associated with the liquidation of any defaulting member or family portfolio under extreme but plausible scenarios;
* Ensure that sufficient liquidity resources are available so that each entity is able to settle all transactions as contracted in the event of a failure by the single largest member or family under extreme but plausible circumstances;
* Exercise continuous improvement of policies, procedures and processes that support robust, ongoing member surveillance and effective but appropriate response to distress events; and
* Manage FR&G to maintain a deep and broad product knowledge and risk framework to effectively measure and manage market, liquidity and credit risks. Market Risk for Fixed Income Clearing Corporation (FICC) and National Securities Clearing Corporation (NSCC) is responsible for the monitoring of daily margin calculation and managing market and liquidity risk exposures arising from trade execution and settlement activities in the clearing corporations and the depository. Responsibilities also include driving new business initiatives, overseeing risk systems design and continuous enhancements, compliance with Risk Management policies and procedures. Responsible for understanding of margining methodologies, keen understanding of financial markets and client profiles, and effectively collaborate with other DTCC teams to identify, analyze, and mitigate potential risks and safeguard financial market in which DTCC plays a pivotal role.

**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
As a Director, you will provide senior leadership across Financial Risk & Governance (FR&G), supporting DTCC’s clearing agencies and critical market infrastructure. You will be accountable for the identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of market and liquidity risk exposures, operating within Board‑approved risk tolerances and regulatory expectations.
  
  
You will serve as a senior leader for the FR&G organization in Chennai, combining direct people management responsibilities with a broader leadership presence across the local Market and Liquidity Risk teams. This is a key role which strengthens DTCC’s global risk operating model, developing talent, and ensuring consistent execution and risk culture across regions.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Provide senior oversight of daily market and liquidity risk activities, including market risk, stress testing, liquidity sufficiency, and member exposure monitoring across DTCC clearing entities as we move toward 24x7 clearing.
* Ensure risk management practices adhere to DTCC policies, procedures, and regulatory expectations, exercising sound [LL1] judgment and timely escalation where required.
* Partner closely with Quantitative Risk Management, Counterparty Credit Risk, and Clearing & Settlement stakeholders to support a cohesive and integrated financial risk framework.
* Drive continuous improvement of risk methodologies, processes, and controls to strengthen resilience under extreme but plausible market stress scenarios.
* Support enhancements to market, liquidity, and stress testing risk systems, tools, and reporting infrastructure through collaboration with technology and other stakeholders.
* Support risk assessments related to new initiatives, products, or material changes as required, consistent with established risk frameworks and governance.
* Lead, develop, and manage Market and Liquidity Risk professionals across the regional offices, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Serve as a senior leadership presence for the FR&G regional offices, fostering engagement, coordination, and collaboration across teams, regardless of reporting alignment.
* Operate effectively in a matrixed environment, influencing stakeholders and driving outcomes across functions and regions, including in the absence of direct management authority.
* Establish strong cross-functional relationships to promote alignment, resolve competing priorities, and deliver consistent execution of risk objectives
* Provide senior leadership and serve as a central point of communication across stakeholders, providing clear, transparent, and timely updates on risk exposure, emerging issues, and strategic initiatives.
* Support responses and inquiries from internal audits, regulatory examinations, and governance reviews, including issue remediation and appropriate escalation to senior management.
* Contribute to global risk governance forums, leadership discussions, and cross‑functional initiatives to support DTCC’s broader risk management strategy and objectives.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 10 years of related experience
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (Master’s, MBA, or equivalent) preferred.

**Talents Needed For Success**

* Significant experience in market risk, liquidity risk, stress testing, or financial risk management within a clearing organization, exchange, bank, or financial market infrastructure environment.
* Proven people leadership experience, including direct line management of managers and/or senior professionals.
* Demonstrated ability to provide leadership influence and coordination across teams without direct reporting relationships, particularly in regional or multi‑location environments.
* Strong understanding of financial markets, margining methodologies, liquidity risk frameworks, and regulatory expectations applicable to clearing agencies.
* Strong communication, judgment, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to operate effectively at senior leadership levels.

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Lead Power Electronics Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As a Lead Power Electronics Engineer, you will serve as a technical authority for the design and development of high-power converters for Solar, BESS, and STATCOM applications. You will own the full product lifecycle—from conceptualization and real-time modeling to prototype validation and grid-code certification. This role focuses on high-efficiency power conversion, grid integration, and robust control systems to support the evolving infrastructure of modern datacenters and renewable energy plants.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Technical Leadership: Lead the development of advanced power converter projects for renewable and datacenter applications from concept through to validated delivery.
* Design & Engineering:

+ Design and specify critical power components, including high-power semiconductors (IGBTs, SiC Mosfets), gate drive circuits, high-speed control boards, and magnetic components.
+ Perform electrical sizing, circuit modeling, and simulation (switching waveforms, loss modeling, and control loops) to meet efficiency and power density requirements.
+ Maintain ownership of engineering artifacts, including SLDs, BOMs, schematics, and design specifications.

* System Integration & Grid Controls:

+ Develop and validate complex control algorithms for voltage-source and current-source converters.
+ Create models of power electronics for use in grid-level power quality and stability studies (Solar/BESS integration).
+ Support system-level integration for datacenter power architectures.

* Validation & Compliance:

+ Define and execute product validation test plans, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and system-level performance testing.
+ Ensure compliance with regional grid codes, IEEE standards, and global safety certifications (UL, IEC, NEC).

* Cross-Functional Collaboration:

+ Interface with customers, sourcing, and manufacturing teams to ensure designs are optimized for manufacturability and project requirements.
+ Mentor junior engineers and promote a culture of engineering excellence and technical rigor.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Master’s degree (PhD preferred) in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum 8–10 years of R&D or engineering experience, with a specific focus on Solar Inverters, BESS, or STATCOM technologies.
* Technical Proficiency:

+ Deep expertise in power conversion topologies (AC/DC, DC/DC, DC/AC).
+ Strong background in semiconductor device physics, loss modeling, and control theory.
+ Proficiency in simulation tools (MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, ETAB) and schematic/layout software (Altium/ORCAD).

* Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading complex engineering projects and mentoring personnel in a global, matrixed organization.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Technical Depth: Experience in high-frequency PCB design, EMI/EMC optimization, and managing stray inductance/capacitance in switching environments.
* Grid Knowledge: Strong understanding of grid-connected inverter behavior, reactive power compensation, and power quality requirements for renewables.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills, with the ability to represent the company in technical forums, standards committees, and customer design reviews.
* Mindset: A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership, high integrity, and a passion for advancing sustainable energy and datacenter infrastructure.

******Additional Information******

Yes

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Level: Manager or equivalent
  
  
We are seeking a Sales Operations Technologist Manager to lead the design and implementation of scalable Sales Operations solutions across CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, and AI platforms. This role combines deep Sales Operations domain expertise with solution architecture, systems integration, automation, delivery leadership, and practical application of Agentic AI.
  
  
The successful candidate will help life sciences organizations improve commercial effectiveness across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, and healthcare businesses. The Manager will lead client engagements, shape solution strategies, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to the growth of our Sales Operations and commercial technology capabilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
As a Manager, you will lead multidisciplinary teams and work directly with client executives, commercial leaders, business stakeholders, IT organizations, data teams, and technology partners to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be responsible for shaping solutions from strategy and discovery through design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
  
  
You will lead and oversee work across the following areas:
  
  

* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable solutions supporting territory and account alignment, segmentation and targeting, quota and incentive planning, sales forecasting, pipeline and opportunity management, account planning, field productivity, pricing and quoting, approvals, and commercial performance reporting.
* Define enterprise solution architectures and delivery approaches integrating CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, workflow, and AI platforms.
* Lead implementations and solution delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, APIs, data models, workflows, accelerators, and delivery standards that can be deployed across client environments.
* Identify, prioritize, and oversee practical Agentic AI use cases, including sales planning assistants, forecasting and pipeline analysis agents, next-best-action recommendations, account and territory intelligence, automated opportunity and CRM hygiene, quoting and approval support, and sales performance insights.
* Define and oversee human-in-the-loop controls, access controls, auditability, evaluation criteria, monitoring, and escalation paths for AI-enabled solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops, process assessments, design sessions, demonstrations, executive discussions, testing, deployment planning, and adoption activities.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives and key stakeholders, facilitate difficult decisions, manage expectations, and communicate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly.
* Manage delivery quality, scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and financial performance across workstreams or engagements.
* Coach and develop consultants and senior consultants through structured feedback, hands-on leadership, and opportunities to expand their domain and technology expertise.
* Establish solution roadmaps, implementation plans, operating models, adoption strategies, governance approaches, and measurable value cases.
* Support and lead pre-sales activities, including account planning, proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, estimates, client presentations, and pursuit strategy.
* Contribute to market eminence, intellectual capital, reusable assets, accelerators, and offerings that strengthen our Sales Operations and commercial technology portfolio.
* Ensure solutions reflect life sciences-specific requirements related to HCP/HCO data, field force structures, regulatory expectations, data privacy, commercial compliance, and data governance.

**The team:**
Step into our
**Sales & Service**
team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 8+ years of consulting or industry experience, including significant experience leading Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, CRM, CPQ, business transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.
* Experience leading end-to-end client engagements or major workstreams, including delivery planning, team leadership, quality management, risk management, and executive communication.
* Strong understanding of Sales Operations processes and performance drivers, including territory and account alignment, segmentation, targeting, quota and incentive planning, forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, pricing, quoting, approvals, and performance reporting.
* Experience implementing or integrating two or more CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, or analytics platforms.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data integration, workflow automation, enterprise solution architecture, and delivery governance.
* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, AI orchestration, or related enterprise AI patterns.
* Ability to convert business requirements into solution strategies, functional designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, roadmaps, and value cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, influence senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve issues, and make sound delivery decisions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing consulting or technology delivery teams

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low-code/no-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, responsible AI practices, and enterprise controls.
* Consulting, systems integration, product management, enterprise architecture, or operating model design experience.
* Experience developing proposals, estimates, solution demonstrations, reusable assets, or market-facing points of view.
* Relevant Salesforce, Veeva, CPQ, cloud, data, architecture, or AI certifications.

**Success Measures**
Success in this role will be measured by:
  
  

* Delivery of high-quality Sales Operations solutions that achieve agreed client outcomes, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Adoption, usability, and sustained business value of implemented solutions.
* Reduction in manual processes, disconnected workflows, and operational friction.
* Improved CRM, Sales Operations, and commercial data quality.
* Faster planning, forecasting, quoting, approval, and decision-making cycles.
* Reusability and scalability of solution components across platforms, business units, and clients.
* Demonstrated business value from AI-enabled capabilities with appropriate controls and monitoring.
* Effective management of data privacy, compliance, security, delivery, and operational risks.
* Strong client relationships, team engagement, talent development, and contribution to pursuit and practice growth.

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

 Location
   

  

 India
   

  

**About The Role**
 The
 **Partner Success Manager** 
 is accountable for helping Kinaxis value added reseller (VAR) partners build productive, scalable, and predictable businesses around Kinaxis solutions. The role connects partner enablement, operating discipline, pipeline governance, and alliance management so that partners are equipped to create demand, progress opportunities, close business, and deliver a consistent customer experience.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on orchestration role. The Partner Success Manager works across VAR leadership, partner sellers and solution consultants, Kinaxis sales, pre\-sales, marketing, services, customer success, operations, and legal teams. The successful candidate combines strong partner relationships with rigorous execution and uses data to identify risks, remove barriers, and improve partner performance.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Develop and manage role\-based partner enablement, onboarding, certification, product training, and ongoing knowledge programs.
* Assess partner capabilities, identify readiness gaps, and drive remediation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Ensure partners can effectively position Kinaxis solutions, qualify opportunities, and leverage Kinaxis resources.
* Drive adoption of approved tools, processes, programs, and new product/solution launches.
* Establish and improve partner delivery readiness and standards to ensure consistent implementation quality and customer outcomes.
* Manage partner operations, governance, business reviews, pipeline cadence, scorecards, records, approvals, and action tracking.
* Partner with VAR sales leaders to build account plans, campaigns, qualified pipeline, and revenue opportunities.
* Lead pipeline reviews, monitor opportunity progression and CRM hygiene, and coordinate internal resources to advance priority deals.
* Analyze pipeline and sales performance metrics to identify risks and drive corrective actions.
* Build strong executive and functional relationships and develop joint business plans with partners.
* Align Kinaxis and partner stakeholders on priorities, responsibilities, investments, and execution.
* Identify opportunities to expand partner capabilities, market coverage, industry reach, and geographic presence.
* Represent partner needs internally while balancing customer outcomes and Kinaxis business priorities.


**Education Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.


 What we are looking for
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales or partner operations.
* Experience working with VARs, system integrators, software partners, or indirect go\-to\-market models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales cycles, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and partner economics.
* Ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and effective execution across stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management, communication, presentation, facilitation, and executive engagement skills.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in CRM, reporting, collaboration, and productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and functions with sound judgment and attention to detail.
* Preferred: Experience in supply chain planning, SaaS, enterprise applications, or digital transformation.
* Preferred: Experience managing global/multi\-regional partner portfolios, partner enablement, certifications, demand generation, channel programs, or complex co\-sell models.


**\#Intermediate, \#Senior**
**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
   

  

 Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

title: Service Delivery Manager, Field Services
description:
Job Description – Service Delivery Manager, Field Services
 



**Company:** 
 Teceze
 



**Position:** 
 Service Delivery Manager – Field Services
 



**Department:** 
 Service Delivery / Operations
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Service Delivery / Operations Director
 



 Role Overview
 



 Teceze is looking for an experienced
 **Service Delivery Manager – Field Services** 
 to manage and drive the successful delivery of onsite IT field services projects across multiple customer locations.
 



 The role will be responsible for end\-to\-end service delivery covering
 **Field IT Support, Smart Hands, Deskside Support, Data Center Support, Network Support, IMACD, Break/Fix, Rollouts, Deployments, and Dispatch Services** 
 .
 



 The SDM will act as the primary operational interface between Teceze, customers, engineers, subcontractors, and internal teams. The individual will be accountable for meeting contractual SLAs, maintaining service quality, managing engineer performance, ensuring timely resource deployment, and improving overall customer satisfaction.
 



 This is a highly operational and customer\-facing role requiring strong experience managing distributed field engineering teams and multi\-site IT support engagements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Service Delivery Management
 


* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of Field Services engagements across assigned customers, countries, regions, or service towers.
* Ensure all onsite IT support tickets, dispatch requests, projects, and scheduled activities are delivered within agreed SLA and quality standards.
* Act as the primary operational point of contact for customers.
* Conduct daily and weekly service reviews with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Track incidents, service requests, escalations, project activities, and engineer performance.
* Ensure customer commitments are clearly communicated and delivered.
* Maintain complete visibility of all active projects, open tickets, pending dispatches, and engineer assignments.
* Ensure services are delivered in accordance with contractual scope, SOPs, work instructions, and customer processes.



 Field Services Operations
 



 Manage delivery across services including:
 


* Deskside Support
* Desktop Support
* End User Computing Support
* Smart Hands
* Remote Hands
* Network Field Support
* Data Center Support
* IT Infrastructure Support
* IMAC / IMACD
* Break/Fix Support
* Hardware Installation
* Hardware Replacement
* Device Deployment
* Device Refresh
* Site Surveys
* Office Moves
* Network Rollouts
* Wi\-Fi Deployments
* Rack and Stack
* Cabling
* Server and Network Device Replacement
* POS Support
* Printer and Peripheral Support
* Project\-Based IT Deployments



 SLA \& KPI Management
 



 The SDM will be responsible for monitoring and maintaining service performance against agreed KPIs and SLAs.
 



 Key metrics may include:
 


* SLA compliance
* Response time
* Engineer acceptance time
* Engineer arrival time
* Resolution time
* First\-time fix rate
* Ticket backlog
* Repeat incident rate
* Engineer utilization
* Engineer attendance
* Customer satisfaction
* Escalation rate
* Ticket aging
* Resource fulfillment time
* Project completion rate



 The role should aim to consistently maintain
 **98% or higher SLA achievement** 
 , subject to customer contractual requirements.
 



 Engineer \& Resource Management
 


* Manage a distributed workforce of Field Engineers, Deskside Engineers, Smart Hands Engineers, Network Engineers, and Data Center Engineers.
* Coordinate with recruitment and sourcing teams to ensure adequate engineer coverage.
* Maintain backup engineer pools for critical locations.
* Ensure rapid backfill when engineers are unavailable.
* Monitor engineer attendance, punctuality, ticket acceptance, and service quality.
* Conduct regular engineer performance reviews.
* Address repeated SLA failures or customer complaints involving engineers.
* Ensure engineers have the correct tools, skills, access, documentation, and site information before dispatch.
* Coordinate engineer onboarding, access approvals, background verification, and customer compliance requirements.
* Maintain skill matrices for engineers across locations.



 Dispatch Management
 


* Ensure all dispatch tickets are assigned within agreed turnaround time.
* Coordinate engineer availability and scheduling.
* Track engineers from assignment through ticket completion.
* Monitor engineer ETA and site arrival.
* Escalate delays proactively.
* Ensure proper communication with customers throughout the dispatch lifecycle.
* Maintain alternate engineer coverage for high\-priority locations.
* Ensure engineers complete all required service reports and closure documentation.



 Project Management
 



 Manage Field Services projects such as:
 


* Desktop refresh projects
* Hardware rollout
* Network equipment replacement
* Data center migration
* Office relocation
* Device deployment
* Wi\-Fi rollout
* Site surveys
* Infrastructure upgrades
* Cabling projects
* End\-user migration
* Store rollout
* Branch rollout
* POS deployment



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Project planning
* Resource planning
* Site scheduling
* Scope validation
* Engineer allocation
* Risk management
* Client communication
* Progress tracking
* Daily reporting
* Issue management
* Quality control
* Project closure



 Customer Management
 


* Build strong operational relationships with customers.
* Act as escalation point for service delivery issues.
* Conduct regular service review meetings.
* Present SLA and KPI performance.
* Discuss open risks, incidents, projects, and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure customer expectations are clearly understood and communicated internally.
* Identify service gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Work closely with account management and sales teams to identify opportunities for service expansion.



 Escalation Management
 


* Own critical service escalations.
* Coordinate internal teams to resolve customer\-impacting issues.
* Establish clear escalation paths.
* Provide timely customer communication during major incidents.
* Conduct root cause analysis where required.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain an escalation log and track actions through closure.

title: Senior Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a
 **Senior Delivery Manager** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
   

  

 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Delivery Manager, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the delivery plan, sprint cadence, milestones and dependency map across parallel workstreams
* Run delivery governance: weekly status, steering committee updates, the RAID log and financial tracking
* Manage scope against the contractual baseline, and raise and negotiate change requests when work moves outside it
* Lead and coordinate architects, engineers, AI and conversation designers, business analysts and QA, including planning when people join and roll off
* Chase and escalate client dependencies such as system access, environments, data and sign\-offs, and clear blockers early
* Build and maintain relationships with client sponsors, product owners and system owners
* Plan and run user acceptance testing, defect triage, release readiness, go\-live and hypercare
* Agree acceptance criteria upfront and tie milestone sign\-off to them
* Set up how benefits will be measured after go\-live, in agreement with the client
* Make sure the team meets client onboarding, access and security requirements, including leaver and access audits


**Requirements**
* Agile delivery across workstreams that move at different speeds, such as platform build and product or conversation design
* Programme planning across parallel streams, including critical path and dependency management
* Executive stakeholder management and clear, early escalation
* Risk, issue and change management
* Test and release management, including UAT planning and go/no\-go decisions
* Enough technical fluency in APIs, cloud and AI or data platforms to challenge estimates and understand why a dependency matters
* 10 or more years in technology delivery, including 5 or more years leading programmes with teams of 10 or more
* A track record of delivering fixed\-price, multi\-stream programmes in large, matrixed enterprises
* Consulting or professional services background with direct client ownership


**Desirable**
* Experience on contact centre, customer experience, conversational AI or automation programmes
* Experience working with enterprise procurement and contingent worker controls
* Delivery certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe or Scrum Master


**Personal Skills**
* Direct and calm under pressure, and comfortable saying no and holding scope
* Escalates early and clearly, rather than absorbing risk quietly
* Builds trust with both client and delivery teams, and keeps both informed without needing to be chased


**What’s in it for you?**
* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
   

  

**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

**Job Description**
**Job Title: Business Relationship Manager**
**Overview**
 The Business Relationship Manager serves as the primary link between the AI team and business units across the organization. The role is responsible for gathering business requirements, prioritizing AI initiatives, supporting technology rollouts, and ensuring successful adoption and business value of AI solutions.
   

  

 The role will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and Learning \& Development to drive adoption, track usage and satisfaction, and address adoption risks.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibility**
* Own and maintain relationships with business unit stakeholders across the organization, serving as their primary point of contact for AI team engagement.
* Gather business requirements and user needs, translating them into prioritized, well\-scoped inputs for the engineering team.
* Define, track, and report on adoption and usage metrics for deployed AI solutions — not just delivery status.
* Design and execute change communication and rollout plans for phased deployments, partnering with Learning \& Development on training hand\-off.
* Serve as the escalation point for business\-unit feedback and concerns regarding AI tooling and automations.
* Identify early signals of adoption risk and drive corrective action before they surface as broader dissatisfaction.
* Facilitate prioritization discussions, bringing business context and stakeholder impact to bear on engineering roadmap decisions.
* Report adoption outcomes, business value, and stakeholder sentiment to executive leadership.
* Build and maintain a repeatable framework for onboarding new business units onto AI\-enabled workflows.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in business relationship management, stakeholder management, product management, customer success, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience driving adoption of new technology or business processes.
* Experience defining and tracking adoption, usage, or satisfaction metrics.
* Experience gathering business requirements and working with technical/engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple business units.
* Working knowledge of AI and automation capabilities and limitations.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment


**Preferred Skills And Experience**
* Experience in financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* Experience supporting AI, automation, or emerging technology rollouts.
* Experience managing relationships across multiple departments.
* Change management certification such as Prosci ADKAR or CCMP.
* Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI\-PBA.
* Product/program management certification such as PMP or CSPO.

title: Service Account Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As a Services Account Manager, you will manage assigned customer service requests and issues from initial quotation through to delivery and issue resolution. Your role ensures a seamless, high\-quality customer experience across the full service lifecycle for the requests and accounts assigned to you. Your responsibilities include:
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Managing assigned customer service requests end\-to\-end — from initial inquiry and quotation through order fulfillment, delivery, and issue closure.
* Preparing and issuing accurate, timely quotations in response to assigned service requests, ensuring alignment with technical and commercial requirements.
* Managing the Inquiry to Order (ITO) process for assigned requests, including coordinating commercial and contractual details with internal stakeholders (engineering, operations, logistics, finance).
* Tracking assigned service requests and orders to ensure timely delivery, proactively communicating status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinating with internal teams (engineering, field service, supply chain) to resolve assigned customer issues, escalations, and technical queries efficiently.
* Ensuring service excellence by monitoring resolution times, quality, and customer satisfaction for assigned requests.
* Communicating clearly with customers throughout the lifecycle of assigned requests, setting expectations and managing follow\-ups.
* Identifying recurring issues or service gaps within assigned accounts and escalating/collaborating with relevant teams (Marketing, Product Line, Engineering) to drive improvement.
* Applying Six Sigma analytical tools, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA), to support resolution of reliability issues and drive continuous improvement in service delivery.
* Maintaining accurate records of service requests, interactions, and resolutions within CRM/ERP systems.
* Supporting strong working relationships with customers on assigned requests to promote satisfaction and repeat engagement.
* Regularly reporting to the APAC Services Operations Manager on assigned request status, open issues, and service delivery performance.
* Staying informed on customer needs, product/service requirements, and regional market conditions relevant to assigned accounts.
* Collaborating with the Services Product Line team to relay customer feedback and support development of new/improved service offerings.
* If you are a detail\-oriented, technically proficient professional passionate about delivering exceptional customer service in the Power Conversion sector across India/APAC, we encourage you to apply for this opportunity with GE Power Conversion.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college/university in Electrical Engineering or allied Engineering discipline. (Master's degree a plus.)
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in customer service, account management, technical support, or service operations.
* Offshore industry experience and process knowledge in one or more of: Metal, Marine, Oil \& Gas, Test Bench, Material Handling, or Power Plant sectors.
* Knowledge of Power Electronics, High Voltage Equipment, and PLC systems.
* Experience with quotation preparation and ITO (Inquiry to Order) processes.
* Willingness to travel across India/APAC region as required.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Prior experience with MV/LV drives, industrial automation systems, and large motors and generators.
* Proficient in both oral and written communication in English (additional regional languages a plus).
* Strong organizational and follow\-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent service requests.
* Customer\-centric mindset with a focus on responsiveness and issue resolution.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with engineering, field service, and supply chain teams.
* Proactive problem\-solver, comfortable working in high\-pressure, matrix\-based environments.
* Experience with CRM/ERP systems for tracking service requests and orders.
* Demonstrated technical proficiency coupled with strong customer service orientation

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Delivery Lead
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Delivery Lead
 



**Location:** 
 Only Chennai\- Hybrid(4 days/week). Not open for other locations at this point
 



**Duration:** 
 Full time
 



**Notice period:** 
 Immediate to 60 days max
 



**Budget:** 
 Open to discuss
 



  





 ⚠️ Important Note
 



**Please do not apply if you have interviewed with Mastech Digital within the past 3 months.** 
 Duplicate/recent interview profiles may not be considered for this opportunity.
 



  





  





**Role Summary** 




*The Delivery Lead (known as Delivery Manager in other organizations) sits between the Delivery Partner and Project Manager in the delivery hierarchy — owning end\-to\-end delivery of Data \& Analytics programs for one or more client accounts, depending on account size, and ensuring governance, quality, and strong client stakeholder relationships. This is a generic role deployed across verticals; specific vertical experience is a nice\-to\-have, not a requirement.* 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of D\&A programs for one or more client accounts, scaling scope with account size and complexity
* Drive program planning, execution tracking, and milestone management across owned accounts
* Embed standardized delivery and automation practices across each account



  





**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as the primary client\-facing point of contact for delivery matters on owned accounts
* Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and proactively manage expectations
* Lead delivery governance forums (status reviews, steering committees) with client leadership



  





**Governance, Quality \& Risk** 



* Ensure delivery governance and quality standards are met across engagements
* Proactively identify delivery risks and drive mitigation and escalation as needed
* Deliver scalable, insight\-driven solutions aligned to client business outcomes



  





**Team \& Project Management Oversight** 



* Direct and mentor Project Managers/project leads within owned accounts, providing delivery direction beyond single\-project execution
* Manage delivery estimation, staffing, and financial performance for assigned accounts
* Track utilization, billing milestones, and margin across owned accounts
* Escalate portfolio\-level risks, resourcing gaps, or growth opportunities to the Delivery Partner where applicable



  





**Must\-Have Skills \& Experience** 



* Strong delivery management experience on analytics/D\&A projects
* Client\-facing experience with senior stakeholders
* Working knowledge of cloud data ecosystems (AWS/Azure/GCP data platforms)
* Solid grounding in delivery governance, estimation, and financial management
* Demonstrated hands\-on delivery ownership, not just program oversight
* Experience directing or mentoring Project Managers, or a track record of managing multiple concurrent workstreams/accounts



  





**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Domain experience in Financial Services \& Payments (FSP) — e.g., SOX, PCI\-DSS, Basel, banking/payments data ecosystems — is a plus
* Domain experience in Healthcare — e.g., HIPAA, HL7/FHIR, payer/provider analytics — is a plus
* Domain experience in Retail — e.g., merchandising, supply chain, or customer/loyalty analytics — is a plus
* Domain experience in Manufacturing — e.g., Industry 4\.0, IoT/OT data, supply chain or quality analytics — is a plus
* PMP, Agile/Scrum, or Scaled Agile (SAFe) certification
* Relevant cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP data or analytics track)
* Experience with delivery reporting/tooling (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI, Tableau)



  





**Education \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field
* 12–18 years of overall experience, including meaningful experience managing and delivering analytics/D\&A projects, with hands\-on client\-facing delivery ownership



  





**Success Looks Like — First 6–12 Months** 



* Strong client relationship established; delivery predictability visibly improved
* Account governance cadences (steering committee, status reporting) fully operational
* Standardized delivery practices and playbooks embedded across owned account(s)



  





**\*\*\*Profiles We Are Not looking at This Point\*\*\*** 



* Pure PMO or BI\-developer profiles without delivery ownership
* Profiles without hands\-on delivery ownership or client interfacing experience
* No prior exposure to Data \& Analytics engagements
